# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.101

Service Date RX Validation now distinguishes patients with no RX history from
patients missing RX for individual service dates, with clickable summary tables,
automatic filters, removable filter buttons, active/inactive and RX-history/date-
coverage filters. Sort every detail column across all results; use top pagination
with up to 1,000 rows, numbered pages and page jump. CSV preserves filters and
sorting across all pages. The responsive filters use aligned columns and equal
40px control heights.

Click detail cells to inspect patient information, exact-date RX, all RX history
or service dates in a read-only popup. Close/Escape restores the same report
filters, page, scroll and focus. Includes missing-RX explanations, RX pharmacy,
arrival, workflow progress and expandable medication quantities. RX details
require RX Records viewing permission; explicit buttons can filter the report.

The compact dashboard **Active patients: no RX** card uses a live, all-history
count matching its patient drilldown. Legacy NULL deletion flags and undated RX
are handled consistently. Hover, click or focus the info icon for the exact
definition and a separate missing-service-date validation link. Historical trends
retain their snapshot scope.

## Installation

Verify SHA256SUMS.txt and LOCAL_VALIDATION.json. Install through Project Control
**option 8 then 15**, preserving .env, configured RX Actions and the paired
application/database rollback set. Require healthy **4.0.0-next.101** and check
Patients validation and the dashboard. **No new migration since next.98 (65 total)**
and no patient/RX rewrite. See docs/SERVICE_DATE_RX_VALIDATION.md. Publication does
not install production.

Preserve external delivery/CSV archives, gzip files, receipts, renderers and the
delivery sequence ledger separately. Older binaries cannot read compressed files;
retain the existing paired rollback and filesystem recovery guidance.

## Validation

Local lifecycle, PostgreSQL report/filter/CSV regressions, CodeQL comparison
against next.100 and extracted compiled-package checks must pass for the exact
source commit recorded in LOCAL_VALIDATION.json. Both executables retain verified
Node.js 22.23.4. Existing source findings, moderate Sequelize/UUID advisories and
unchanged Softphone dependency warnings remain disclosed.
